fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole bass boat (2012 Skeeter TZX 190) with trailer.
findings: Grey carpet on the rear deck looks faded and a bit dusty in the on-water and console photos
Water spotting and dust visible on the dash bezel, gauge faces and around the Humminbird unit
Hull and blue gelcoat stripe look reasonably glossy from the side shot, though it is taken at a distance
Outboard cowling appears glossy with decals in good shape
Grey vinyl seat tops look slightly dull in a couple of shots
message: Hi Doug, we saw your listing for the 2012 Skeeter TZX 190. It looks well kept, but the deck carpet and dash area look a little dusty and water spotted in the photos, and a clean-up and wax on the hull would help it pop for buyers. We do pre-sale boat details and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
